## Introduction

This package makes calculating DFBETA correlations very easy. Here's how you do it.

```{r}
library(Package)

# Import your data from somewhere
data <- data.frame(
    X = c(1, 1, 2, 3, 5)
    , M = c(3, 4, 3, 5, 9)
    , Y = c(7, 4, 4, 2, 1)
)

# Create regression models
model_a <- lm(M ~ X, data = data)
model_bc <- lm(Y ~ X + M, data = data)

# Calculate DFBETAs
Package::get_dfbetas(model_a, model_bc, "X", "M")
```
